table_description: Tiny lookup table (20 rows) defining annual household income ranges. Each row is an income band with a lower and upper bound in dollars. Referenced by HOUSEHOLD_DEMOGRAPHICS.HD_INCOME_BAND_SK. Use when you need actual dollar ranges rather than just the HD_BUY_POTENTIAL bucket.
use_cases: Revenue segmentation by customer income level
High-income vs low-income customer purchase patterns
data_quality_notes: IB_LOWER_BOUND and IB_UPPER_BOUND are annual income in US dollars.
To get income band for customers: JOIN CUSTOMER -> HOUSEHOLD_DEMOGRAPHICS -> INCOME_BAND.
This table has only 20 rows — very safe to join.

table_columns.name: IB_INCOME_BAND_SK
table_columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Referenced by HOUSEHOLD_DEMOGRAPHICS.HD_INCOME_BAND_SK.

table_columns.name: IB_LOWER_BOUND
table_columns.description: Lower bound of annual household income in USD.

table_columns.name: IB_UPPER_BOUND
table_columns.description: Upper bound of annual household income in USD.
